title: The magnetic field along the motion
spoken: The magnetic field component along the motion is the same in both systems.
explanation: The component of the magnetic field along the direction of motion is unchanged by the change of system.
assumptions: The moving system moves along x at speed v relative to the stationary system, with |v| < c. Modern teaching notation: gamma is the paper's beta, c its V.
Fields in empty space, in SI units; E is the electric field and B the magnetic field, with components along x, y and z.

notes.title: What it asserts
notes.explanation: Only the components across the motion mix.

notes.title: Magnetic field, moving system
notes.explanation: The magnetic field in the moving system, one component; the subscript names which.

notes.title: Magnetic field, stationary system
notes.explanation: The magnetic field in the stationary system, one component; the subscript names which.

sentence.text: The magnetic field along x in the moving system
the same component in the stationary system
